intro: Kamaneeyamaina is the latest Telugu Christian song written & produced by Joshua Shaik, Passion For Christ Ministries, sung by Anwesshaa Dutt and Music composed by Thrahimam fame, Pranam Kamalakar. This song video was released on September 16, 2020 under the label, Impact Zone India.
